findings.highlight: Now we’re drinking tea after dinner
findings.evidenceJa: そんなこんなで食後のお茶会になった
findings.governingReading: after one thing and another, it had turned into an after-dinner tea gathering
findings.explanation: The lightly comic transition into a shared tea gathering becomes a bare activity report.

findings.evidenceJa: 緑茶をずずー、とすすって
findings.governingReading: I noisily sip my green tea
findings.explanation: Shirou’s contrasting drink and comic sipping sound disappear.

findings.evidenceJa: つまんない言葉知ってる
findings.governingReading: you know such trivial little terms
findings.explanation: Rin’s backhanded jab is reversed into praise.

findings.evidenceJa: [ruby text=オリジナル char=2]本物に数段劣る
findings.governingReading: several grades inferior to the genuine originals
findings.explanation: The magnitude of Shirou’s inferred quality loss disappears.

findings.highlight: the same ability as the original
findings.governingReading: the same performance as the original
findings.explanation: An object’s functional performance is mislabeled as an ability.
Rin’s personal address during instruction disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 表現方法、伝承、売り文句等に
findings.governingReading: in its mode of portrayal, legend, sales pitch, and so on
findings.explanation: The distinct ways an “unbreakable” identity is constructed are collapsed.

findings.highlight: the scales between you and reality tip
findings.evidenceJa: その秤が崩れてしまう
findings.governingReading: the balance between you and reality collapses
findings.explanation: A breakdown of the comparison framework becomes an ordinary shift in balance.

findings.evidenceJa: アレがどんな位置づけだったか
findings.governingReading: how those swords were situated in your understanding
findings.explanation: Shirou’s conceptual model is recast as a quality ranking.

findings.highlight: make them disappear from this world
findings.explanation: The English adds a metaphysical destination claim absent from Rin’s explanation.

findings.highlight: how it was considered to be made
findings.evidenceJa: 何故それを作る気になったのか
findings.governingReading: why its maker decided to create it
findings.explanation: The creator’s motive becomes an impersonal, malformed account of process.

findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂がぼけっとしている
findings.explanation: Rin’s vacant pause is interpreted as shock.

findings.evidenceJa: 無責任なコトを言いだした
findings.explanation: Shirou’s judgment of Rin’s proposal becomes a structural claim about the conversation.

findings.highlight: That hasn’t helped me too much
findings.evidenceJa: 今まで役に立ったコトなんてない
findings.governingReading: it has never once been useful
findings.explanation: A categorical record of failure is weakened.

findings.evidenceJa: 白兵戦に長けた[ruby text=マスター char=2]葛木
findings.governingReading: Kuzuki, a Master skilled in close combat
findings.explanation: A key tactical reason Caster cannot be approached disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: キャスターの軍門に下ったら
findings.governingReading: once Saber has entered Caster’s camp in submission
findings.explanation: The concrete military-subordination image and Caster’s control are weakened.

findings.highlight: She told me as she cried
findings.evidenceJa: 涙をこぼしながら告げたセイバー
findings.governingReading: Saber told me while shedding tears
findings.explanation: The English’s generic crying loses the visible tears marking Saber’s plea.
